evidenceCaveat: Manual validation corpus, not independently verified ground truth. Visual cross-checks do not establish exact event identity with Xweather Live events.

observations.detail: Substantial lightning activity was manually observed across the broader Saint-Gilles / Nîmes / Mediterranean area during the relevant period; this is regional context, not exact-point verification.
Windy ECMWF Rain/Thunder view showed a thunder/lightning signal in the area for the relevant period. Manual visual cross-check only; it does not establish exact event identity.

expectedInterpretation.summary: Possible evidence gap rather than evidence that the 700 J/kg threshold alone is wrong.
candidateMechanisms: strong forcing with very low CIN

observations.detail: Lightning Nearby Live showed strong nearby current activity in the broader La Palma / Villahermosa area. One observed card reported 116 Xweather Flash events within 10 km / 5 minutes. This is a Flash-event count, not a count of cloud-to-ground strikes; Flash records may be CG, IC, or unknown.

Blitzortung showed activity in the same broader area, with visually fewer plotted events. These products may differ in provider coverage, event unit, detection, and display; the count difference alone does not establish an error.

expectedInterpretation.summary: The CAPE + precipitation fallback was useful in this case. The Live-selected location was close to, but not necessarily identical with, the forecast debug coordinate.
expectedInterpretation.regressionNote: 0 / 40 ICON member support must not automatically downgrade deterministic Elevated or High. Member support is not a thunderstorm probability.

observations.detail: Lightning Nearby Live showed nearby activity. One manual Live check reported nearest activity about 2.9 km southwest and 8 Xweather Flash events within 10 km / 5 minutes. Flash events are not asserted to be ground strikes.

Windy ECMWF Rain/Thunder showed a thunder/lightning field immediately adjacent to the selected point, especially toward the south/east. Manual visual evidence suggests a boundary or displacement case, not a strong exact-point deterministic signal.

expectedInterpretation.summary: Lowering CAPE alone from 700 to 500 J/kg would not rescue this case because exact-point precipitation probability was 10%. A deterministic spatial miss or model displacement is a candidate explanation.
futureResearch: debug-only deterministic neighborhood sampling at center and nearby N/E/S/W points within roughly 10–15 km
expectedInterpretation.researchConstraint: Keep neighborhood sampling research-only until validated.

observations.detail: Lightning Nearby Live later showed nearby activity during the forecast High period. A manual check around 09:30 local reported nearest event about 9.4 km east, age about 2 minutes, and 1 Xweather Flash event within 10 km / 5 minutes.
Blitzortung showed nearby lightning detections in the broader Ponza area. The Xweather Live event and Blitzortung detections are not claimed to be the same physical event.

expectedInterpretation.summary: Direct WMO thunderstorm code correctly yielded High; CAPE, precipitation, low CIN, and 29 / 40 ICON-EU EPS supporting members were also supportive. This is a do-not-break case for future classifier experiments.
